workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: flow schema upgrade-on-read writes the whole trigger tree unconditionally, so a read can clobber a concurrent draft edit
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(flows): flow edits no longer lost when someone opens the flow right after an upgrade. Target files: packages/server/api/src/app/flows/flow-version/flow-version-migration.service.ts, packages/server/api/test/integration/ce/flows/flow-version/flow-version-migration.test.ts. Fixes [GIT-1881](https://linear.app/activepieces/issue/GIT-1881) (Ref: https://github.com/activepieces/activepieces/pull/17345)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Step output copy buttons toast "Copied to clipboard" even when the clipboard write is rejected
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(builder): step data copy button no longer shows "Copied" when the clipboard write is blocked. Target files: packages/web/src/app/builder/flow-canvas/utils/bulk-actions.ts, packages/web/src/app/builder/data-display/copy-ai-prompt.tsx, packages/web/src/app/builder/data-display/data-display-tabs.tsx.
